complexity.notes: The two branches for positive and negative x do essentially the same work and could be unified by splitting off the sign with abs(x) first. An ||arithmetic digit-extraction loop (repeatedly taking x % 10)|| is the classic alternative and has the same O(n) complexity here, so the string approach is fine.
complexity.summary: Converts x to a string, reverses the digit characters (slicing off the sign for negatives), and lexicographically compares the 10-digit result against the 32-bit bound strings to decide between the reversed value and 0.
